api_metadata.name: OMD Sandbox API
api_metadata.purpose: A mock target server designed for testing Apigee API Gateway policies, fault handling, latency, and payload transformations.

capabilities: Network latency simulation via artificial delays.
HTTP Request header reflection for Apigee Trace validation.
Automatic payload resolution based on requested status code and content type.

/info.description: Returns this API documentation and the complete catalog of loaded static payloads.

/echo.description: Returns the exact HTTP request metadata received by the server (method, headers, query parameters, and body). Useful for verifying what Apigee forwarded.

/test.description: Dynamic testing endpoint controlled by query parameters.

status.description: The HTTP status code to return. It is dynamically injected into the 'code' field of generic payloads.

delay.description: Artificial delay in milliseconds before the response is sent. Used to test timeout policies.

payloadType.description: Determines the format of the auto-selected payload if an explicit payload ID is not provided.

payload.description: Overrides auto-selection. Set to a specific ID (e.g., 'json_404') to force a payload, or 'body' to echo the incoming request body.

headers.description: If set to true, request headers are reflected as HTTP response headers prefixed with 'omd-header__'.

/test.resolution_logic: When 'payload' is not set to a specific ID or 'body', the API cascades through the catalog: Exact Match (e.g., json_404) -> Category Match (e.g., json_4xx) -> Global Fallback (e.g., json_xxx).
